name: Text
label: Text
description: Running text in a tier of the type scale, with tones, truncation, and tabular figures.

props.name: tier
props.description: The type style: `paragraph` for body copy, `paragraph-sm` for helper copy and table cells, `caption` for the smallest notes, `overline` for an eyebrow above a title, `code` for an inline identifier in the code face.

props.name: as
props.description: The element it renders as. Defaults to `p`; `span` sits inside a line, `label` names a control (pass `htmlFor`).

props.name: tone
props.description: The colour role: `default` the primary text, `neutral` the secondary for quieter copy, a status role for a message of that kind, `inherit` the surrounding colour.

props.name: weight
props.description: `emphasis` sets the tier's emphasis weight, the one heavier weight the type scale gives running text.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Keep the text on one line, ending in an ellipsis where it runs out of room.

props.name: lines
props.description: Clamp the text to this many lines, ending in an ellipsis. Overrides `truncate`.

props.name: numeric
props.description: Tabular figures, so digits line up in a column of amounts or times.

props.name: align
props.description: Where the text sits on the line, along the reading direction. `end` lines up a column of amounts.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: The control this text names, when `as` is `label`.
